components.gap: The model-selection objective is never stated as a selection rule: the body defines L(x,theta)=L(e|theta)+L(theta) (l.112-120) and 'the published score' U_R (l.255-258), but nowhere says the estimated structure (n,m) is the minimizer of U_R (or of the constant-retaining surrogate Q_*) over the declared candidate orders, as source eq. (4.10) ('to be minimized with respect to the structure parameters n and m', p.471) does; the method (l.290-298) says only 'Compare the published score'. Only the literal finite-code variant (l.299-301) and a passing mention of joint minimization (l.302) state a minimization. State the argmin selection rule over candidate structures explicitly.
